## Summary

Describe the public recipe, documentation, or test behavior changed by this pull request and link its issue.

## Verification

List the checks you ran and any intentionally manual validation.

## Safety checklist

- [ ] I ran `scripts/check.sh --require-optional all`, or explained why an optional host-specific check could not run.
- [ ] I updated documentation and tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] I did not add operating-system media, ROMs, installed disks, NVR state, product keys, private paths, personal data, or other non-redistributable material.
- [ ] New downloads point to an official source and document relevant trust or licensing limitations.
- [ ] The pull request closes or references its tracking issue.
